hook: Six public figures face 34.5 million pounds in legal costs after losing a privacy lawsuit.

sections.voiceover: Six public figures face 34.5 million pounds in legal costs after losing a privacy lawsuit.
b_roll: Motion graphic showing financial scale with legal fee ticker reaching 34.5 million pounds

sections.voiceover: In July 2026, London judge Mr Justice Nicklin dismissed claims against Associated Newspapers Limited. Will these six claimants actually pay the 34.5 million pounds in joint legal costs?
b_roll: Map graphic highlighting London court location
Timeline bar marking the 11-week trial duration
Animated graphic featuring a large question mark over legal fee totals

b_roll: Graphic motion revealing Court of Appeal document icon dated November 2026

sections.voiceover: They are now challenging the 34.5 million pound indemnity order meant to cover the publisher's expenses.
b_roll: Graphic icons representing Prince Harry, Sir Elton John, and Elizabeth Hurley
Split flow diagram showing High Court dismissal vs Court of Appeal challenge
Legal document graphic highlighting indemnity costs order text

sections.voiceover: London's Court of Appeal will now decide if these six claimants must pay the bill.
